messages:
maria_support: Heads up — customer 'BeaconHealth' opened a ticket: their invoice shows ~2.3k extra prompt tokens for 2026-03-12 compared to the dashboard. They say their client had a network flake and retried, but dashboard shows only 1.8k. Can we check for replayed requests or metering duplication? :thinking:

raj_billing: Thanks Maria. Can you paste the invoice delta and a sample request_id or session id? We should check ledger events and metering ingestion times.

maria_support: Invoice excerpt: `2026-03-12 00:00-23:59: billed_tokens: 12430` Dashboard export for same org/time: `tokens_consumed: 10085`. Customer sent one sample request_id: `req_8f3c2a9d` and client trace id: `trace-x7b9`. They also said the client logged three retries within ~10s.

alex_infra: Pinging metering pipeline — I can search by req_id and trace. Also want gateway logs (nginx/ngtcp) around that timeframe.

metering-bot: ingest_event: {"ingest_ts":"2026-03-12T14:02:11Z","req_id":"req_8f3c2a9d","tokens":350,"duplicate_key":null}
metering-bot: ingest_event: {"ingest_ts":"2026-03-12T14:02:12Z","req_id":"req_8f3c2a9d","tokens":350,"duplicate_key":"replay-45f"}

kevin_engineering: Those bot lines look suspicious — a duplicate_key on the second ingest suggests the gateway replayed the same request and our ledger recorded both. Does the gateway set idempotency-key header? Customer SDK should send `Idempotency-Key`, but we haven't enforced on ingress.

raj_billing: If ledger has two ingests for same req_id we may have billed twice. Can we confirm whether billing dedupe ran? Querying ledger: `SELECT count(*) FROM metering_events WHERE req_id='req_8f3c2a9d' AND ingest_day='2026-03-12'` returns 2 rows.

alex_infra: Found gateway 10.4.1.22 logs showing connection reset and proxy retry at 14:02:11 -> 14:02:12. Snippet:
```
[2026-03-12T14:02:11Z] nginx-proxy[conn=xyz] proxy_pass backend1, req_id=req_8f3c2a9d, status=200, bytes=512
[2026-03-12T14:02:12Z] nginx-proxy[conn=xyz] retrying backend request due to upstream timeout, new attempt req_id=req_8f3c2a9d
```

kevin_engineering: That confirms request replay without a new idempotency-key. Two ingests later caused ledger duplication. Root cause: gateway retry logic re-fired the same req_id header instead of dropping or attaching a new marker.

maria_support: Customer's SDK didn't send Idempotency-Key. They used default HTTP client auto-retries which resent the same payload. They expected dashboard to dedupe.

raj_billing: For remediation: we can credit the duplicate row for this org. I'll open a billing adjustment once we identify all duped req_ids. We need a reliable query to find replayed events in that day.

alex_infra: Query idea: look for groups (req_id, ingest_ts) where count>1 within short window and duplicate_key is not null OR gateway retry flag present. I'll dump candidate list and share.

metering-bot: candidate_dup_count=7 matches for org BeaconHealth on 2026-03-12: [req_8f3c2a9d, req_a12b7c3e, req_d9f3b001, ...]

kevin_engineering: Long-term fix options: 1) Ingress should reject automated proxy retries if upstream already returned 200 (safe-guard), 2) enforce or require Idempotency-Key for non-idempotent endpoints and treat identical req_id as same event, 3) enhance billing pipeline to dedupe by (req_id, payload_hash) within X seconds.

maria_support: For immediate customer response: offer a billing credit for the confirmed dupes, explain they should ensure SDK uses Idempotency-Key and disable client auto-retries for non-idempotent calls.

raj_billing: I'll prepare the credit and policy note. tagging finance compliance. Leaving action items: alex to dump full candidate list (ETA 2h), kevin to open infra PR for ingress retry guard (ETA 2d), raj to file credit (ETA EOD).

alex_infra: Dumped CSV to private S3 with candidates. Shared link in ticket.

maria_support: Thanks — I'll update the customer and attach the credit reference. :+1:

kevin_engineering: Filed PR: ingress/disable-proxy-retry-on-200 — small guard to stop re-forward when upstream had success. Review welcome.

raj_billing: Closing loop — credit applied for 7 duplicate events, total refund ~0.0028 USD (token-based). I'll follow up if anything else pops up.

maria_support: Great teamwork. I'll add SDK guidance to our KB and ping SDK team to recommend Idempotency-Key examples.
